name: Canonical Contract terminology requires artifact-wide inspection

input.fixture_ref: Scan normative Iris v1 type, reflection, migration, native, library, and conformance artifacts for non-canonical Contract terminology.

applicability.reason: Supported as a DOCUMENTATION audit. C086 makes Contract terminology exclusive OUTSIDE clearly labeled history or migration replacement text, so the audit distinguishes the CONCEPT sense from unrelated senses: a networking protocol, the `to_bool` protocol, the Iterator protocol and the C ABI are all legitimate, which is why a naive scan reported hits in nine chapters and every one checked was fine. The row states the concept-sense pattern and the labels that exempt a line, and the validator reports any line matching the former without the latter.

absent_pattern.concept: interface declaration|trait declaration|protocol declaration|interface conformance|trait conformance
